comment: Mpp7 controls subsequent (spontaneous) regioselective Knoevenagel condensation

reactions.description: Mpp7 controls regioselective Knoevenagel condensation: Mpp7 mediates regioselective aldol condensation on the C6 ketone group and that the subsequent dehydration step is spontaneous, whereas the absence of Mpp7 leads to lactone ring formation on C9a.
